up: Retrieve a list of all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4118110. For each such molecule, return its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), the maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), the molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and the canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). If a molecule does not have a structure in compound_structures, still include it but show NULL for the SMILES. Include each molecule only once in the output. Sort the result by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS "ChEMBL ID", md.pref_name AS "Name", md.max_phase AS "Maximum Phase", md.molecule_type AS "Molecule Type", cs.canonical_smiles AS "Canonical SMILES" FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4118110' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
